alinea.source: Papageorgiou et al. 1991 (ALINEA): K_R = 70 veh/h per occupancy %, updated every 60 s. Target just below critical occupancy: the simulator converts occupancy to density as occupancy % x jam density / 100, and motorway critical density 20 / jam density 150 = 13.3 %. Minimum rate 240 veh/h = one car every 15 s - placeholder, calibrate from loop data

signals.source: HCM 2010 base saturation flow 1900 pc/h/ln; lost time per phase ~4 s (start-up + clearance, Webster 1958) - placeholder, calibrate with stopwatch surveys / Arahan Teknik (Jalan) 13/87
